source: Reused same-session official PyPI wheels, verified RECORD and full MIT texts, and retained exact-version OSV responses; frozen service environment validated separately.
productionExportComparison: Exact raw stdout bytes, including comments and editable project entry; no normalization.
distributionBoundary: Development source-comment parsing only. No parser code is copied into the service wheel or Runtime; the service production --no-dev wheelhouse excludes these four packages. Distributing a development environment or these tools requires preserving every upstream MIT copyright and license text.
licenseAssessment: The original wheel LICENSE texts below grant MIT permission including redistribution and require retaining their copyright and permission notices. This bounded development-tool use is compatible with the unchanged AGPL-3.0-only project license. Metadata alone was not treated as original license evidence.
advisoryLimit: The retained same-session precise PyPI-name/version OSV responses listed no advisories. Their supply-evidence capture times are recorded per package; exact individual HTTP query times were not separately recorded. No new OSV requests or whole-library rescan were made. This does not prove absence of unknown vulnerabilities or future advisories, nor bound arbitrary parser inputs.

abiValidation.scope: Installed Linux x86_64 service environment; no macOS or Windows loading claim.

scopeLimit: Qualified Shell, CSS and Java comment adapters only. Shell exact shebang and CSS conservative context guards remain required. Java rejects every raw ASCII backslash plus lowercase u before parsing; this intentionally rejects some valid escaped literals and is not full JLS validation. All adapters reject ERROR, missing, root.has_error and uncertain raw coordinates. HTML/native and other unsupported languages remain blockers; final global counts require the root audit. No per-file quota or relaxation of strict global >40%.

packages.adoptionBoundary: Qualified raw UTF-8 Java only; reject any ASCII backslash followed by lowercase u before parser construction, including valid literal false positives; no Unicode translation or normalization.

htmlIncrement.adoptionBoundary: Qualified UTF-8 HTML source only, with canonical external scripts and empty or ASCII-whitespace bodies. Ambiguous comment context, unsupported markup or any parse error rejects the whole input.

formalWheelhouseExports.comparison: 在同一私有目录以相同命令、环境重放Git基线和最终锁清单；当前仓库实际最终导出与重放逐字节一致。无项目源码/共享环境变更。
